protocol.panel: 30 deterministic episodes x 8 non-overlapping H=8 states per task
protocol.execution_error: the exact frozen 64 x H=8 Jenga translation tracking snippets at 1x
protocol.pushing_map: snippet xyz -> commanded planar xy (z discarded)
protocol.insertion_map: snippet xyz -> xyz plus yaw=snippet_x/(20*sqrt(2) mm), so yaw has the same corner displacement
protocol.trajectory: three anonymous rigid-body slots; position/rotation-6D/linear/angular velocity
protocol.monitor: frozen Regime Monitor v0 unchanged: 64 probes, H8, hold30, 3 pairs, 5 bisections
protocol.grading: task success/failure/mode labels are attached before monitor scoring and never enter it
protocol.primary_gate: >=50% consequential task-outcome-fork recall in each task and >=25 percentage-point separation from unanimous quiet
